notes.title: Super Zoo Story Launches Kickstarter on Oct 1st – New Trailer Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey, future zoo keepers! 🦁🐧

We have some exciting news to share! After years of hard work and passion, we’re thrilled to announce that Super Zoo Story will be launching a Kickstarter campaign on October 1st, 2024. This campaign will help us bring our dream of creating the ultimate wildlife sanctuary experience to life, and we can't wait to take you along on this journey!

To give you a sneak peek at what’s in store, we’ve just dropped a brand-new teaser trailer. It has fresh gameplay footage, including glimpses of the diverse habitats, the vibrant townsfolk, and, of course, the amazing array of animals you’ll care for in your sanctuary. Whether you're excited about building, exploring, or simply enjoying the pixel-art charm, this trailer has something for everyone.

[previewyoutube=SANtrDg0l5I;full][/previewyoutube]

Mark your calendars for October 1st, 2024, and stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to the launch. We’re incredibly grateful for your enthusiasm and support, and we can’t wait to embark on this adventure together!
